title: Grateful Dead Live at Memorial Coliseum on 1973-06-24
source: MSBDR > 1 cassette gen > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a superb Dark Star performance – one of the nicest versions you'll hear.
ai_review.review: The consensus among reviewers is that this recording delivers a particularly strong Dark Star, often described as “delicious” and “nice.” The sound‑board source provides clear audio, with only a minor chop noted in the post‑Eyes jam. Overall the show is praised despite a few picky listeners noting it isn’t their absolute favorite.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is 4.6/5, with consistent praise for the Dark Star and no major complaints about the audio; recording quality is good enough to support a highly enjoyable performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and well‑balanced soundboard capture; a slight chop noted in the jam after Eyes but otherwise solid.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set highlighted by an extended Dark Star; reviewers mention a post‑Eyes jam (Stronger Than Dirt) that, while enjoyable, contains a minor imperfection.
